verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an email SaaS, so publishing an official MCP server for external agents is a fair question. The evidence only shows Shortwave's own AI Assistant acting as an MCP client ('Add custom integration' and pointing to an MCP server of your choice). That is client-side support and cannot be credited to this server story. Nothing in the pack shows a first-party Shortwave MCP server or hosted endpoint that outside agents could connect to.
